org.asynchttpclient.extras.rxjava.single

Class AsyncHttpSingle

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.asynchttpclient.extras.rxjava.single.AsyncHttpSingle

  • public final class AsyncHttpSingle
extends Object
    Wraps HTTP requests into RxJava Single instances.

    https://github.com/ ReactiveX/RxJava

    • Method Detail

      • create

        public static rx.Single<Response> create(BoundRequestBuilder builder)
        Emits the responses to HTTP requests obtained from builder.
        Parameters:
        builder - used to build the HTTP request that is to be executed
        Returns:
        a Single that executes new requests on subscription obtained from builder on subscription and that emits the response
        Throws:
        NullPointerException - if builder is null

      • create

        public static rx.Single<Response> create(rx.functions.Func1<? super AsyncHandler<?>,? extends Future<?>> requestTemplate)
        Emits the responses to HTTP requests obtained by calling requestTemplate.
        Parameters:
        requestTemplate - called to start the HTTP request with an AysncHandler that builds the HTTP response and propagates results to the returned Single. The Future that is returned by requestTemplate will be used to cancel the request when the Single is unsubscribed.
        Returns:
        a Single that executes new requests on subscription by calling requestTemplate and that emits the response
        Throws:
        NullPointerException - if requestTemplate is null

      • create

        public static <T> rx.Single<T> create(BoundRequestBuilder builder,
                                      rx.functions.Func0<? extends AsyncHandler<? extends T>> handlerSupplier)
        Emits the results of AsyncHandlers obtained from handlerSupplier for HTTP requests obtained from builder.
        Parameters:
        builder - used to build the HTTP request that is to be executed
        handlerSupplier - supplies the desired AsyncHandler instances that are used to produce results
        Returns:
        a Single that executes new requests on subscription obtained from builder and that emits the result of the AsyncHandler obtained from handlerSupplier
        Throws:
        NullPointerException - if at least one of the parameters is null

      • create

        public static <T> rx.Single<T> create(rx.functions.Func1<? super AsyncHandler<?>,? extends Future<?>> requestTemplate,
                                      rx.functions.Func0<? extends AsyncHandler<? extends T>> handlerSupplier)
        Emits the results of AsyncHandlers obtained from handlerSupplier for HTTP requests obtained obtained by calling requestTemplate.
        Parameters:
        requestTemplate - called to start the HTTP request with an AysncHandler that builds the HTTP response and propagates results to the returned Single. The Future that is returned by requestTemplate will be used to cancel the request when the Single is unsubscribed.
        handlerSupplier - supplies the desired AsyncHandler instances that are used to produce results
        Returns:
        a Single that executes new requests on subscription by calling requestTemplate and that emits the results produced by the AsyncHandlers supplied by handlerSupplier
        Throws:
        NullPointerException - if at least one of the parameters is null
